tools.name: whoami
tools.description: The project this token is for.

tools.name: moab_deck_deal
tools.description: Deal more agent cards for this project (a background job; call again later and read the deck with moab_experiments_context). size 1 to 5.

tools.name: moab_deck_swipe
tools.description: Swipe a dealt card: right puts it in the sandbox (drafts go only to the founder), left passes it. Never sends anything.

tools.name: moab_templates_list
tools.description: The message templates agents use, with the evidence behind each.

tools.name: moab_senders_status
tools.description: Which senders are connected and healthy. No secrets.

tools.name: moab_replies
tools.description: Recent replies from prospects (text only, newest first).

tools.name: moab_experiments_context
tools.description: What is being tested and what the last 7 days counted: agents, their numbers and verdicts, what is working, the goal and how far along it is.

tools.name: moab_agent_update
tools.description: Edit the copy (subject, body, name) or the sequence (steps: visit, invite with a note of 200 characters, the message, follow-ups; notes and follow-ups may use only {{first_name}} and {{company}}) of a sandbox or dealt agent. A live agent is 409 agent_live: only a person changes it, in the app. Never

tools.name: moab_signups_setup
tools.description: Count the project's sign-ups toward its goal and the agent whose link brought each one. Turns sign-up tracking on (tracked links then land with ?moab=<code>) and returns a new key, shown once (any earlier key stops working), and the snippet for the site: the page keeps the code, the site's server po

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "moab_senders_status" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Which senders are connected and healthy. No secrets.
